messages:
maria_gonzalez: Hey @deal-desk — small embed-heavy POC with HealthStart. They want to use Hosted API but this is low-dollar, high-embed volume. Asking for a temporary per-token override to $0.0005 for embeddings for 30 days and waiver of the standard mincharge. Can we do a short pilot exemption?

alex_weiss: quick context — product wants minimal friction. If mincharge stays, they drop to a self-hosted eval. Customer is EU-based and expects ~2M embed tokens first month.

sam_sales: Customer can't commit to a large reserve. Could we trade a small soft commit (eg $3k refundable credit) for the lower unit price? Or do a ramp: low $/token for month1 then standard.

liz_salesops: Need business justification + ARR motion. What’s LTV/qualification? Also legal will want an explicit pilot amendment.

erica_pricing: Doing rough math — 2M tokens @ $0.0005 = $1,000. Our floor/mincharge is $2,000 so this is an exception. I'm open to a 30–60 day pilot exemption with hard usage cap and explicit end date. Need sales exec sign-off for deviation.

andy_engineer: technical note — embeddings at scale are batching-heavy; cost backend-side is predictable. No special infra impacts expected for 2M tokens, EU-hosted.

deal-desk-bot: Automated check: per-token price below approved floor flagged. Non-standard pricing requires deal-desk review + CRO or Finance approval. Attach SOW and pilot terms to accelerate.

alex_weiss: Proposed path: offer 30-day pilot at $0.0005 for embeddings up to `2.5M tokens` with a hard cap, no mincharge during pilot. If usage > cap, revert to standard pricing. Sales to get exec email ok.

erica_pricing: I'm comfortable approving a 30-day pilot at $0.0005 up to `2.5M tokens` if sales secures exec sign-off (email) and ops/legal get the amendment. Add clause: costs billed against a $3k pre-funded credit to avoid surprise.

liz_salesops: I'll draft a short amendment + SOW labeled "pilot discount" and add the usage cap. @maria_gonzalez please DM customer contact and the exact billing email for invoicing/credit.

maria_gonzalez: shared customer contact & use-case in DM. Product also asked for SLA waiver for pilot — looping legal & product for that. Thanks all. :thumbsup: 

deal-desk-bot: Approval route: pending. Escalated to @erica_pricing and @cto for final sign-off on pricing exceptions.

alex_weiss: @andy_engineer can you confirm fallback routing (dedicated EU pool) if we see burst above hosted baseline during pilot?

andy_engineer: Confirmed — capacity OK. We can route to dedicated EU fallback if latency/burst exceed thresholds. No expected infra changes for this pilot.

maria_gonzalez: Great — I'll collect exec sign-off and legal amendment then update thread. Targeting pilot start next week if approved.

(threads like this typically end with an action item checklist; I'll follow up in the channel when we have signed amendment.)
